newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business Sept 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business Sept 6.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Sept 6:
WASHINGTON - Giant Food named Stephen Neal to a vice president post created to further relationships with minorities.
WASHINGTON - Wireless communications companies are learning firsthand about the difficulties of billing for their services.
WASHINGTON - IBM rolled out one of the first "network computers", a new type that some industry leaders think will change the face of computing.
WASHINGTON - Regulation-watchers are trying to assess cost and impact of rules that Clinton administration has put in place.
